title: Cloudflare SSR adapter not configured in astro.config.mjs
close_reason: False positive: site uses output: static which deploys to Cloudflare Pages without the adapter. The adapter is only needed for SSR/hybrid mode.

title: Boids: Build boids.js simulation engine (Canvas 2D, triangle boids, attraction/repulsion, trails)
description:
## Requirements

- **50 boids** default count
- **Isosceles triangle** shape for each boid (pointing in direction of travel)
- **Left-click** on canvas attracts nearby boids toward cursor
- **Right-click** on canvas repels nearby boids away from cursor
- **Short faded trails**: ~5-8 frame trail behind each boid, fading to transparent
- **Site accent colors**: use `--color-accent` / dark mode `--color-accent` variants, switch automatically with dark/light mode
- **Canvas at devicePixelRatio**: render at native resolution for sharp visuals
- **requestAnimationFrame** loop at 60fps target
- Standard boids algorithm: separation + alignment + cohesion
- Respect container resize (canvas resizes with panel)
close_reason: Closed

title: Boids: Integrate Boids component into index.astro and add panel animations to global.css
description:
## Requirements

- Add smooth open/close keyframe animations to `src/styles/global.css`
- Polish the hero-to-left transition when panel opens (CSS transitions on width/transform)
- Wire up Escape key to close panel
- Click-outside-to-close behavior for the panel
- Ensure panel respects dark/light mode
- Final visual polish pass on the panel border, text styling, spacing
close_reason: Closed

title: Boids: Create Boids.astro component with Bored button and expandable half-screen panel
description:
## Requirements

- **"Bored?" button** placed as a 4th CTA in the Hero's button row
- **Lord Icon**: hash `bazecvhf` for the button icon
- **Canvas element**: placeholder canvas that fills the panel area, ready for boids.js to take over
- **Right-half panel**: clicking the button expands a panel that takes roughly the right 50% of the viewport
- **Hero content shifts left**: when panel opens, the hero text/buttons move left to make room
- **Canvas border**: panel has a border around the canvas area with:
  - **Top**: interaction description ("left-click to attract, right-click to repel")
  - **Bottom**: short explanation of how boids work
- **Close button**: × button to collapse the panel
- **Mobile**: detect mobile viewport and hide the "Bored?" button entirely (no panel on mobile)
- **Import into index.astro**: place `<Boids />` in the hero area so the panel coexists with hero content
- **Basic open/close** using a CSS class toggle or reactive state (smooth transition can come in xw5)
close_reason: Closed

title: Duplicate publication URL - copy-paste error
description:
## Issue

The 3rd publication in `src/data/publications.yaml` (Faleel et al., "Whats the Thumb Doing?") has the **same URL** as the 1st publication (Banerjee et al., "ThumbSwype"):

```
url: https://dl.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3769872.3769893
```

Both papers share DOI `10.1145/3769872.3769893`. The Graphics Interface (GI) 2025 paper should have a different DOI.

### Fix
Find and update the correct DOI for the GI 2025 paper.
close_reason: Fixed: updated DOI for the GI 2025 paper

title: Placeholder/demo projects in projects.yaml - Jane Smith data
description:
## Issue

`src/data/projects.yaml` contains **fake/demo project data** referencing "Jane Smith" — TaskFlow, DevMetrics, FormKit, WeatherNow, MarkdownBlog, PixelArt. These are clearly copy-pasted from a template or starter.

### Current state
- 6 fake projects with placeholder descriptions, links to example.com and github.com/janesmith/*
- The Projects component is commented out in index.astro

### Fix
Either:
1. Replace with real projects and uncomment the component
2. Remove the YAML data entirely until real content is ready
3. Add a hidden flag so the data stays but does not render

### Impact
If someone uncomments the Projects component before replacing the data, the site will display fake content.
close_reason: Deferred: user will replace placeholder projects with real content later

title: tsconfig.json includes only worker-configuration.d.ts
description:
## Issue

tsconfig.json extends astro/tsconfigs/strict which is good, but its include directive only covers worker-configuration.d.ts. Source files under src/ are not explicitly included.

Current:
"include": ["./worker-configuration.d.ts"]

Fix: add src patterns to include so src/lib/types.ts, src/lib/data.ts, and src/content.config.ts are properly type-checked by the TS language server outside of Astro's own pipeline.
close_reason: Expanded tsconfig include to src/**/*.ts and src/**/*.astro. Fixed all surfaced type errors (scrollToTarget declarations, implicit any, null checks, unused imports). Created src/env.d.ts for global declarations. astro check: 0 errors.

title: Large inline scripts in Navbar.astro and Projects.astro
description:
## Issue

Two components have **large inline `<script>` blocks** that should be extracted:

- `Navbar.astro`: ~180 lines (scroll classes, mobile menu, nav underline lerp, smooth scroll)
- `Projects.astro`: ~120 lines (filtering, expand/collapse, card clicks, description toggles)

These scripts increase component complexity, cannot be cached independently, and mix framework code with vanilla JS.

### Fix
Extract to `public/scripts/main.js` or separate modules under `public/scripts/`:
- `public/scripts/navbar.js`
- `public/scripts/projects.js`

Use `DOMContentLoaded`-style initialization with feature detection (check if element exists before binding).
close_reason: Extracted Navbar (~180 lines) and Projects (~120 lines) inline scripts into main.js. Build passes, astro check: 0 errors 0 warnings.

title: No main landmark on homepage - accessibility issue
description:
## Issue

`src/pages/index.astro` renders sections directly inside `<body>` without a `<main>` landmark. Blog pages have `<main>` but the homepage does not.

### Current (index.astro)
```astro
<BaseLayout ...>
  <Navbar />
  <Hero />
  <About />
  ...
</BaseLayout>
```

### Fix
Wrap sections in `<main>`:
```astro
<BaseLayout ...>
  <Navbar />
  <main>
    <Hero />
    <About />
    ...
  </main>
</BaseLayout>
```
This improves accessibility for screen-reader users who navigate by landmark regions.
close_reason: Wrapped homepage sections in <main> landmark. astro check passes.

title: Deprecated LI constant imported and used in all 10 components
description:
## Issue

`src/lib/data.ts` defines `LI` with `@deprecated Use LORD_ICON_COLORS instead`, yet **every single component** imports and uses `LI`:

```
import { load, LI, liSrc } from "../lib/data";
```

Used in: Navbar, Hero, About, Experience, Publications, Skills, Education, Contact, Footer, Projects — and referenced as `LI.dark`, `LI.light`, `LI.blue`.

### Fix
1. Replace all `LI.dark` with `LORD_ICON_COLORS.default`
2. Replace `LI.light` with `LORD_ICON_COLORS.onDark`
3. Replace `LI.blue` with `LORD_ICON_COLORS.accent`
4. Remove the deprecated `LI` export
5. Update imports to use `LORD_ICON_COLORS` instead
close_reason: Replaced all LI.dark/LI.light/LI.blue with LORD_ICON_COLORS across 9 components. Removed deprecated LI export from data.ts. astro check passes.

title: Duplicated scrollToTarget function in 3 components
description:
## Issue

The `scrollToTarget` smooth-scroll function is **copy-pasted identically** in three files:

- `src/components/Hero.astro` (lines 90-102)
- `src/components/Navbar.astro` (lines ~144-156)
- `src/components/Contact.astro` (back-to-top, lines ~120-132)

### DRY violation
All three define the same 15-line cubic ease-out scroll animation. Should be extracted into `public/scripts/main.js` and exposed as a global utility.

### Fix
1. Move `scrollToTarget` to `main.js`
2. Export it on `window` (e.g., `window.scrollToTarget`)
3. Replace inline copies with calls to the shared function
close_reason: Extracted scrollToTarget to main.js. Replaced inline copies in Hero, Navbar, and Contact. astro check passes.

title: Unused @astrojs/cloudflare dependency
description:
## Issue

@astrojs/cloudflare is listed in package.json dependencies but is never used. The site uses output: static which deploys to Cloudflare Pages without any adapter — Pages serves the dist/ directory natively.

The Cloudflare adapter is only needed for SSR/hybrid mode with Cloudflare Workers. For a static site, it is dead weight.

### Fix
Remove @astrojs/cloudflare from dependencies:
npm uninstall @astrojs/cloudflare

Optionally also remove wrangler as a devDependency if it is only used for the Cloudflare adapter (but re-check if wrangler is needed for CLI deploys).
close_reason: Removed unused @astrojs/cloudflare dependency (npm uninstall)

title: Email exposed in plaintext in YAML source and JSON-LD
description:
## Issue

The email rishavbanerjee1710@gmail.com appears in plaintext in src/data/site.yaml. While the Contact component HTML-obfuscates it with char codes for display, the raw YAML source is still in the public repo and is also exposed in the JSON-LD structured data in BaseLayout.astro as mailto:rishavbanerjee1710@gmail.com.

### Fix
The JSON-LD has it as:
email: site.email ? `mailto:${site.email}` : undefined

Consider removing the email from the source-controlled YAML entirely and using an environment variable, or at least obfuscating it in JSON-LD the same way it is in HTML.
close_reason: Removed email from JSON-LD structured data. Email still works via obfuscated HTML in Contact component.

title: Images are PNG-only with no WebP versions
description:
## Issue

public/profile.png and public/og.png are PNG-only. No WebP or AVIF equivalents exist. WebP versions would be significantly smaller (30-50% reduction) with no visible quality loss.

### Fix
Generate WebP versions:
- public/profile.webp
- public/og.webp

Use a picture element or srcset in BaseLayout to serve WebP to modern browsers with PNG fallback.
close_reason: Skipped: user will handle image optimization separately

title: Missing .editorconfig file
description:
## Issue

No .editorconfig file exists. This means editor settings like indent style, charset, and line endings are not enforced at the project level. The .prettierrc covers formatting but not editor basics.

### Fix
Create a .editorconfig:
root = true
[*]
charset = utf-8
end_of_line = lf
insert_final_newline = true
trim_trailing_whitespace = true
indent_style = space
indent_size = 2
[*.md]
trim_trailing_whitespace = false
close_reason: Skipped: user handles editor config via Emacs

title: YAML load() silently returns empty object on parse failure
description:
## Issue

src/lib/data.ts load() function catches YAML parse errors and silently returns {} cast as T. It does log via console.error, but the caller has no way to detect the failure.

This means:
- A malformed YAML file causes a section to render empty with no obvious error
- The developer may not notice the console.error during development
- The site silently degrades

### Fix
Option 1: Throw on parse failure instead of returning {}
Option 2: Add a data validation step at build time that checks all required YAML files
Option 3: At minimum, add a visible build warning or toast in dev mode
close_reason: load() now throws on YAML parse failure instead of silently returning {}

title: Missing .env in .gitignore
description:
## Issue

The .gitignore file does not include a .env pattern. If environment variables are ever needed (e.g., API keys, Cloudflare tokens), they could accidentally be committed.

### Fix
Add to .gitignore:
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
close_reason: Added .env and .env.* to .gitignore with !.env.example exception

title: Blog has only a draft post - no published content
description:
## Issue

The only blog post (src/content/blogs/welcome.md) has draft: true and is correctly filtered out by both blogs.astro and [slug].astro.

This means the /blogs page shows "No posts yet. Check back soon!" which is fine for now, but the site has no published blog content despite having the full blog infrastructure built out.

### Fix
Either:
1. Set draft: false on the welcome post if ready to publish
2. Write a real introductory post with draft: false
3. Leave as-is but document that blog content is pending
close_reason: Skipped: user will publish blog posts later

title: Missing SVG favicon link in BaseLayout
description:
## Issue

public/ contains both favicon.ico and favicon.svg but BaseLayout.astro only links to the .ico:
  <link rel="icon" sizes="any" href="${baseUrl}/favicon.ico?v=1" />

SVG favicons are supported by all modern browsers and provide crisp rendering at any size. The SVG file exists but is never referenced.

### Fix
Add an SVG favicon link for modern browsers:
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="${baseUrl}/favicon.svg" />

Keep the .ico as fallback for older browsers.
close_reason: Added SVG favicon link before .ico fallback in BaseLayout

title: Hardcoded 2026 copyright year in contact.yaml
description:
## Issue

src/data/contact.yaml has a hardcoded copyright year:
  copyrightPrefix: '2026 Rishav Banerjee. Built with '

This will be outdated in 2027. Since this is a static YAML file, the year cannot auto-update.

### Fix
Option 1: Remove the year from the YAML and render it in the Footer component using new Date().getFullYear().
Option 2: Use a range like "2024-2026" that ages better.

The Footer.astro component already renders the copyright line from YAML. Just compute the year at build time.
close_reason: Stripped year from copyrightPrefix in YAML, now computed dynamically via new Date().getFullYear() in Footer.astro

title: robots.txt missing sitemap reference
description:
## Issue

public/robots.txt does not reference the sitemap. The project uses @astrojs/sitemap which auto-generates a sitemap at /sitemap-index.xml, but robots.txt has no Sitemap: directive.

### Fix
Add to robots.txt:
Sitemap: https://rishav-banerjee.com/sitemap-index.xml

This helps search engines discover all pages.
close_reason: Added Sitemap: https://rishav-banerjee.com/sitemap-index.xml to robots.txt

title: Hardcoded Lord Icon hash in Hero blogs CTA
description:
## Issue

src/components/Hero.astro uses a hardcoded Lord Icon hash 'hmpomorl' for the blog CTA button:

```
<lord-icon src={liSrc('hmpomorl')} trigger="morph" colors={LI.dark} class="li-lg" />
```

This should come from hero.yaml so it is data-driven like all other icons. Currently there is no icon field on the blogs CTA in the Hero type or YAML.

### Fix
1. Add optional icon field to the blogs CTA in hero.yaml
2. Update Hero.astro to use hero.cta.blogs.icon || 'hmpomorl' as fallback
close_reason: Added icon field to blogs CTA in hero.yaml, updated Hero type, made Hero.astro data-driven
